segmentler.metin: The Cuyahoga River caught fire in Cleveland.
It took only oil-soaked industrial debris on the water.
So how could oil-soaked industrial debris on the water do this?
The answer is industrial pollution leaving flammable oil and debris floating on the river — and it is why it helped spur the Clean Water Act amendments and the EPA.
